show.description:
A honeymoon in a remote cottage turns into a nightmare when a seductive, bloodthirsty spirit begins to stalk a newlywed couple.
Driven by obsession, she wants only one thing—to claim the husband forever. A chilling tale where love, fear, and dark desire collide in terrifying ways.
